paragraphs: Section 3.5: Pin Configuration and Peripheral Mapping for Chapter 3 (System Design)

The microcontroller STM32F103C8T6 is configured with the arduino_stm32core framework, which leverages the STM32 HAL drivers to manage peripheral operations. The pin configuration and peripheral mapping are detailed below.

The peripherals are mapped according to their respective functionalities. The ADC1 peripheral is used for soil moisture measurement, while the GPIOs are utilized for alert triggers and status indicators.
The operational state ranges and indicator logic are defined as follows:
bullets: Description**: This pin is connected to the Soil Moisture Sensor's Analog Out, allowing for analog soil moisture voltage measurement.
Functionality**: It is configured as an input pin with a 12-bit resolution using the `ADC1` peripheral in the HAL library.
Pin Name**: PA0
Usage**: This pin is used to read the soil moisture value from the sensor.
Description**: This pin is connected to the Active Buzzer Alert Driver, enabling audible alert triggers on low soil moisture levels.
Functionality**: It is configured as an output pin using the `GPIO` peripheral in the HAL library.
Pin Name**: PA1
Usage**: This pin is used to trigger an alert when the soil moisture level falls below a certain threshold.
Description**: This pin is connected to the Onboard Status LED, providing an active-low status indicator.
Functionality**: It is configured as an output pin using the `GPIO` peripheral in the HAL library.
Pin Name**: PC13
Usage**: This pin is used to indicate when action is needed by turning on the onboard LED.
Description**: This pin is connected to the USB-to-UART Adapter RX, enabling serial telemetry and debug monitoring at 115200 baud.
Functionality**: It is configured as an output pin using the `USART` peripheral in the HAL library.
Pin Name**: PA9
Usage**: This pin is used to transmit data over UART for debugging and telemetry.
Description**: This pin is connected to the USB-to-UART Adapter TX, enabling serial receiver interface.
Functionality**: It is configured as an input pin using the `USART` peripheral in the HAL library.
Pin Name**: PA10
Usage**: This pin is used to receive data over UART for debugging and telemetry.
Description**: The ADC1 peripheral is configured with a 12-bit resolution.

Usage**: This pin is connected to the Soil Moisture Sensor's Analog Out, allowing for analog soil moisture voltage measurement.
